counter_hypotheses: Large Binance whale deposits may be sale preparation, but can also reflect internal wallet reclassification, custody movement or OTC settlement.
The 4 November large Binance withdrawal and same-wallet-set exchange-balance decline are counterevidence to a simple one-way exchange accumulation story.
The November 9 ETF outflow is large for one session but follows a positive multi-session/cumulative history on some trackers; it does not by itself establish persistent institutional exit.
Long-heavy derivatives positioning can amplify downside liquidations, but positive funding is not a price forecast and aggregate provider coverage differs.
